title: Mock test
description: A full-length test on the real exam pattern. Also used for previous year papers (manifest kind 'pyq'), which are the same shape plus provenance fields — a past paper is a mock that really happened. Questions are referenced by id rather than embedded, so the bank stays the single source of truth and a content correction reaches every paper that uses it. scripts/validate.py resolves every id against the banks.

durationMinutes.description: Total wall-clock time. When sectionalTiming is true this must equal the sum of the section durations.

sectionalTiming.description: True when each section has its own locked timer and the candidate cannot return to a finished section (Tier 2). False for one shared timer with free movement (Tier 1).

isDemo.description: Marks a short sample that does not follow the full exam pattern. The app labels these so a candidate is never misled about their readiness.

year.description: Year this paper was actually held. Required for previous year papers, null for authored mocks.

examDate.description: Date the paper was held, when known.

shift.description: Sitting identifier, e.g. 'Shift 2'. SSC runs several shifts per day and the papers differ.

source.description: Provenance of the paper, e.g. 'SSC official answer key'. Previous year papers must say where they came from.

durationMinutes.description: Required when the mock uses sectional timing; must be null otherwise.

negativeMarks.description: Deducted per wrong answer. Unanswered questions are never penalised.

questionIds.description: Ordered. Every id must exist in a published question bank whose subject matches this section.
